newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen stock climbs further on share issue.
newsitem.headline: Loewen stock climbs further on share issue.

text.p: Shares in the Loewen Group Inc extended gains Friday after the funeral-home operator's US$396 million share offering was well received.
Loewen stock was up 1/8 at 33-1/8 in New York after peaking at 33-1/4 earlier. In Toronto, the shares gained 0.40 to 45.80. Trading was brisk.

Loewen closed an offering of 12 million shares, each priced at US$33, on Thursday evening. The offering size was increased from 10 million shares and the total raised exceeded the company's earlier estimates of up to US$350 million.

Analysts said Loewen's efforts to market the issue were successful. Company executives met with investors across North America and Europe, sending the message that Loewen had recovered from a rocky period, it was poised for strong growth and its stock was undervalued relative to its peers.
The end of the share offering also eliminated an overhang of new supply that had weighed on the market recently, traders said.
